newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks turn around on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks turn around on profit-taking.

text.p: Mexican stocks reversed earlier gains and were slightly off in late trade on Monday following profit-taking at light trade, dealers said.
"You couldn't say this was more than profit-taking, because investors are freewheeling right now," said a trader.
"I also think they're taking profits to switch to Cetes as primary rates are expected to gain this evening," he added.
The blue-chip IPC index was was off 4.38 points, or 0.13 percent, at 3,328.51. Volume was light at 35.9 million shares traded.
A Reuters survey of money market traders showed they expected Banco de Mexico to assign bellwether 28-day Cetes rates at an average of 27.85 percent, or 85 basis points more than last week's rate.
